messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: Mangrove birds-internal errors-ignore?
parts:
Azlan:

Hard to tell exactly what those errors mean without looking more deeply
at the Distance project, but anytime Distance produces an error or
warning message it is something to think about. You should ponder
whether what Distance is having trouble doing, is something you really
ought to have it do.

According to the Appendix of the Distance Users Guide, both of the
messages you mention (102 and 76) arise from the multiple covariate
(MCDS) engine rather than the CDS engine. My suspicion is that there
are some combinations of the covariates (are you using species as a
covariate?) for which you have few data and there are difficulties in
fitting a detection function. I would doubt that the mechanical
remedies that you tried will be of much value.
